dedupe_keys.name: reference system for current sensor calibrations at power frequency and for wideband frequencies

description: Yeying Chen and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The physical reference system calibrates current sensors at power frequency and across wideband conditions. Coverage includes 50 Hz currents up to 5 kA and frequencies up to 9 kHz. The source reports expanded uncertainties with k=2 below 20 microA/A and 10 microrad at 50 Hz, and 0.01% and 0.04 crad for wideband conditions. A centring unit improves Rogowski-coil uncertainty. The setup supports power-quality and wind-turbine efficiency measurements, but these stated bounds do not establish performance for every sensor or operating configuration. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
